outcome_evidence: Twelve focused scenarios cover mandatory public bounded choice, invalid kind/index transactionality, metadata rejection, mode-specific own-creature bonus/keywords and end-step/departure triggers in both seats.
Both nonmana source-grant cost payment and tap-green mana availability/funding are mode-specific; suppression removes and later restores selected providers while retaining the choice.
Graveyard land permission obeys ordinary land timing and allowance and ends on source departure.

Control changes preserve the choice and change live recipients. In-place copies get no chosen value, activation or conditional trigger; original acquisitions restore dormant choices; true reentry and entering copies make fresh choices.
A queued trigger still resolves after an in-place copy and simultaneous departures use frozen source modes after live choices clear.

Projected entry choices match committed bonuses and mana templates without mutating the parent. Raw/index children agree, siblings remain independent after parent disposal, wrong actors and stale revisions preserve state, and restore reproduces the outcome.
Thirty-seven existing max-speed grants, copied entry choices, named-entry privacy and owned-state regressions remain passing.
